_note: 1.2.2 bond system, single source for the engine (tools/gen_engine.py), the UI (tools/gen_ui.py) and the Now entry (tools/gen_mvu_entries.py). Edit here, then rebuild. xp_base[r] = XP from Rank r to Rank r+1 at standard pace; cool_base[r] = days after reaching Rank r before its next bond event can start. pace multiplies both (full rank: fast ~1 month, brisk ~2 months, standard ~1 semester, slow ~1 year of diligent play).
_note_close_at: 1.5.0 (N3a): a bond is marked close in <now> once its XP reaches this share of the next rank's need (before the bar is full).

start._note: 1.3.1 (owner playtest): a bond that does not start at Rank 0. Applied once, when the engine first records the bond (the first scene they share); the next event waits for that rank's cooldown.

Etnie.Title: Self-declared big sister
Known_facts: Third-year, Viridian (dog beastkin); insists she is {{user}}'s big sister
Milestones: Etnie decided {{user}} is her little sibling

share: how they look and their public role
their name, age, club and where they spend time
the magic and skills they use openly
their personality and what shows when they are upset
what they think of other people and of the Doves

perks.1: greets {{user}} and can be found at their usual places
perks.2: accepts invitations (a meal, study, a walk)
perks.3: sometimes seeks {{user}} out; remembers the birthday
perks.4: will spar, study or team up (competition teams included)
perks.5: shares their goal and may ask for help with it
perks.7: takes real risks for {{user}}: covers, lends points, backs {{user}} up with staff
perks.8: closest bond: best friend, romance or sworn rival (the rank 8 event decides)
perks.9: acts for {{user}} unasked; their secret begins to surface

themes.0: A first real conversation: past the small talk, {{user}} learns who they actually are.
themes.1: They show the magic or the skill they are proud of, or let {{user}} watch them work.
themes.2: A small moment reveals what they love or can't stand.
themes.3: {{user}} sees another side of them: a bad day, a crack in the usual face.
themes.4: They tell {{user}} what they want most, and a way to help appears.
themes.5: They speak honestly about the people around them, and about the Doves.
themes.6: They tell {{user}} about their past and their family.
themes.7: A turning point: the bond becomes best friends, romance or a sworn rivalry, and the event lets {{user}} choose.
themes.8: They start to let their guard down about what they hide; the story opens a way to the truth (never revealed by rank alone).
themes.9: The peak of the bond: a moment that proves it, and what they would give up for {{user}}.

_note_you_line: 1.4.2 (owner): People -> Connections, your own line to someone takes a kind from the bond. Romance first (Bonds.<id>.Romance), then the first rule here whose conditions all hold (tension_from, trust_below, trust_from, rank_from, title = a word in Bonds.<id>.Title); none = a plain gold bond line. arrow: the line is their view of you (them -> you); otherwise it is shared. The line is thicker with rank. 1.4.3: the Trust thresholds follow data/trust.json (Doubtful under 35, Trusting from 65).
_note_recent: 1.4.4 (owner): each bond keeps its latest `keep` moments with {{user}} (Bonds.<id>.$Recent: when, one sentence, effect), shown in the dossier newest first; <now> gives the narrator the newest `now` of them for each present character. The sentence is the Note the narrator adds to an interaction; without one, the kinds (phrases).
